nusmp.page.book_dream.drowsy_mist: Drowsy Mist - a pastel mist rolls out in front of you; every foe in the cone takes a small hit and grows drowsy (Slowness II and Weakness for 4 seconds). Damage scales with your EP like the rest of the book.
nusmp.page.book_dream.counting_sheep: Counting Sheep - three dream-woolly bolts leap out and home in on the nearest foes, each one slowing what it hits for 1.5 seconds. The tier's damage is shared between the three.
nusmp.page.book_dream.pillow_burst: Pillow Burst - an imagined pillow bursts around you in a cloud of stars and feathers: foes within 3.5 blocks take a light hit and are shoved back.
nusmp.page.book_dream.lucid_step: Lucid Step - you know you are dreaming and simply walk 8 blocks forward through the dream, then keep a burst of Speed II for 3 seconds. A pure move, no damage.
nusmp.page.book_dream.dreamcatcher_ward: Dreamcatcher Ward - a woven ward catches the bad dreams of you and up to five allies within 7 blocks: harmful effects are shaken off and everyone gains Absorption II and Resistance for 10 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_dream.mind_read: Mind Read - you listen to the thoughts of every foe within 12 blocks (up to six): they glow for 8 seconds so you can follow them, and the strain leaves them weakened for 5. No damage.
nusmp.page.book_dream.dream_nightmare_se: Nightmare Seed - a seed of bad dream flies to where you aim and blooms: foes within 2.5 blocks take a hit and are plunged into Darkness and Weakness for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_dream.slumber_field: Slumber Field - a field of drifting dream mist where you aim, 5 blocks wide for 4 seconds: every second foes inside take a pulse and are heavily slowed (Slowness III) and weakened.
nusmp.page.book_dream.pastel_garden: Pastel Garden - a garden of sweets and flowers blooms where you aim for 4 seconds: you and your allies in it are healed a little every second and gain Regeneration, foes in it are slowed.
nusmp.page.book_dream.sleepwalker: Sleepwalker - you drift on through the dream unnoticed: mobs within 16 blocks that hunt you lose you, and you turn invisible and quick (Speed II) for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_dream.eternal_slumber: Eternal Slumber - the whole room falls asleep: up to ten foes within 9 blocks take a heavy hit, then Slowness IV, Weakness and Darkness; if the shared control lock is free they are also frozen (3 seconds on a player, 1 on a boss).
nusmp.page.book_illusion.mirage_prism_ra: Prism Ray - a ray bent through a false mirror runs 10 blocks: every foe along it takes a hit and is slowed for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_illusion.afterimage_bolt: Afterimage Bolt - three afterimages of a bolt fan out; whichever is real hits, and anything it touches is dizzied (Nausea) for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_illusion.vertigo_ring: Vertigo Ring - the floor seems to turn: foes within 3.5 blocks take a light hit, are pushed off balance and left dizzy for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_illusion.illusion_mirage: Mirage Walk - you flicker through 9 blocks as a heat-haze double, cutting everyone on the way and blinding them for 1.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_illusion.illusory_visage: Illusory Visage - you wear the face of your foes' worst fear: everything in a wide 7 block cone takes a hit, is shoved back, weakened (II) and slowed (II).
nusmp.page.book_illusion.phantom_host: Phantom Host - five phantoms of you rush out and home in on your foes, each blinding what it strikes for a second. The mid-tier damage is shared out between the five.
nusmp.page.book_illusion.paralyzing_illu: Paralyzing Illusion - the foe under your crosshair believes it is bound hand and foot and stops moving (the shared control lock and diminishing returns apply), dizzy for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_illusion.endless_corrido: Endless Corridor - the ground where you aim becomes a corridor with no end: for 4 seconds foes within 5.5 blocks keep being drawn back to its middle, slowed, and take a pulse every two seconds.
nusmp.page.book_illusion.curtain_of_lies: Curtain of Lies - a shimmering curtain hides you and up to five allies within 8 blocks (Invisibility for 8 seconds, Speed) and every mob within 18 blocks that hunted you loses the trail.
nusmp.page.book_illusion.illusion_realit: Reality Break - the lie shatters all at once: up to ten foes within 7 blocks take a heavy hit, are thrown back, dizzied for 6 seconds and blinded for 3.
nusmp.page.book_air.gust_jab: Gust Jab - a short jab of compressed air in a narrow cone, 4 blocks long: a light hit and a hard shove.
nusmp.page.book_air.air_needles: Air Needles - four thin needles of air fan out; the starter damage is shared between them, so a close foe takes most of them.
nusmp.page.book_air.featherfall_gift: Featherfall Gift - the air thickens under you and up to five allies within 8 blocks: Slow Falling for 20 seconds and a short burst of Speed. Utility, no damage.
nusmp.page.book_air.air_updraft: Updraft - a column of air shoots up around you: foes within 3.5 blocks take a hit and are thrown into the air.
nusmp.page.book_air.compression_lance: Compression Lance - air squeezed into a needle-thin lance that runs 14 blocks and hits everyone on its line.
nusmp.page.book_air.air_pressure_wall: Pressure Wall - a wall of dense air stands in front of you: up to eight enemy projectiles in it are swatted away and foes at it take a hit and a shove.
nusmp.page.book_air.pressure_rampart: Pressure Rampart - a ring of hard air follows you for 4 seconds: whatever comes within 4 blocks is shoved away again and again and takes a small pulse.
nusmp.page.book_smoke.smoke_bomb: Smoke Bomb - a ball of smoke flies to where you aim and bursts: foes within 3 blocks take a light hit and are blinded for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_smoke.hermits_thick_smok: Hermit's Thick Smoke - you wrap yourself in a thick cloud: foes within 5 blocks are blinded for 4 seconds and slowed, and you turn invisible for 3. No damage.
nusmp.page.book_smoke.smoke_double: Smoke Double - a puff of smoke takes your place: mobs within 16 blocks that hunted you lose you, and you turn invisible and quick (Speed II) for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_smoke.smoke_choking_fume: Choking Fumes - a gout of acrid smoke fills a 7 block cone: foes take a hit, are poisoned and slowed for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_smoke.degenerate_kings_s: Degenerate King's Smoke Prison - the foe under your crosshair is walled in by smoke and cannot move (shared control lock, diminishing returns) and cannot see for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_smoke.billowing_wall: Billowing Wall - a rolling wall of smoke surrounds you for 4 seconds: foes within 4 blocks are pulsed, blinded and slowed (Slowness II).
nusmp.page.book_smoke.smoke_garden_of_us: Smoke Garden of Usurpation - a garden of poison smoke where you aim, 5 blocks wide for 5 seconds. It never touches you or your allies; foes in it take a pulse every second and are poisoned, weakened and slowed.
nusmp.page.book_vortex.eddy_bolt: Eddy Bolt - a spinning bolt that bursts on impact and drags the foes within 2 blocks back toward you.
nusmp.page.book_vortex.swirl_kick: Swirl Kick - a spinning kick sends a whorl of wind through a 4 block cone: a light hit that throws foes aside and a little up.
nusmp.page.book_vortex.vortex_centrifuge: Centrifuge - you spin and fling everything off you: foes within 3.5 blocks take a light hit and are hurled outwards.
nusmp.page.book_vortex.vortex_undertow: Undertow - the air around you turns inwards: foes within 6 blocks take a hit and are dragged toward you (a boss only a third as far).
nusmp.page.book_vortex.vortex_whirlpool_: Whirlpool Snare - a small whirlpool of air closes around the foe under your crosshair and holds it still (shared control lock), dragging it a little toward you.
nusmp.page.book_vortex.vortex_cyclone_la: Cyclone Lance - a corkscrew of wind runs 14 blocks, hitting everything on its line and winding the foes in toward you.
nusmp.page.book_vortex.vortex_maelstrom_: Maelstrom Ring - a ring of turning wind follows you for 4 seconds: foes within 5 blocks are drawn in and pulsed every half second.
nusmp.page.book_wing.feather_flick: Feather Flick - you flick a razor feather that bursts into a puff of down where it lands: a light hit within 1.5 blocks.
nusmp.page.book_wing.wing_downbeat: Downbeat - one great beat of your wings flattens the air around you: foes within 3.5 blocks take a light hit and are pushed back.
nusmp.page.book_wing.glide_grace: Glide Grace - wings of light lift you and up to five allies within 7 blocks: Slow Falling for 20 seconds and Jump Boost II for 10. Utility, no damage.
nusmp.page.book_wing.wing_soaring_leap: Soaring Leap - you beat your wings once and leap high and far forward, with Slow Falling for 6 seconds so the landing is soft. A mobility page, no damage.
nusmp.page.book_wing.wing_talon_rake: Talon Rake - claws of feathers rake a 5 block cone: a mid-tier hit, a push and a short slow.
nusmp.page.book_wing.feather_mantle: Feather Mantle - a mantle of feathers wraps you for 10 seconds: your melee blows hit harder, attackers are pricked, and you gain Resistance and Slow Falling.
nusmp.page.book_wing.skyward_gale: Skyward Gale - a gale lifts off your wings for 3 seconds: foes within 5 blocks are pulsed every second and thrown up and away.
nusmp.page.book_wind.cutting_breeze: Cutting Breeze - three thin crescents of wind fly out in a fan; the starter damage is shared between them.
nusmp.page.book_wind.thiefs_wind_cloud: Thief's Wind Cloud - you gather the wind streams into a cloud and ride it 12 blocks forward, then keep Speed II for 4 seconds and Slow Falling for 5. A mobility page, no damage.
nusmp.page.book_wind.wind_veil: Wind Veil - a veil of wind wraps you for 10 seconds: your melee blows hit harder, attackers are cut by the wind, and you gain Speed II and Slow Falling.
nusmp.page.book_wind.spirit_of_euros: Spirit of Euros - the east wind of Sylph's sister spirit runs 16 blocks along your sight: everything on the line takes a hit, is shoved hard and weakened for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_wind.spirit_of_notos: Spirit of Notos - a shield of wind stands around you for 3 seconds: enemy projectiles within 5 blocks are blown away (up to six per half second), foes are pushed back, and you and your allies there gain Resistance. No damage.
nusmp.page.book_wind.saint_spirit_of_zep: Saint Spirit of Zephyr - Sylph's saint power: a tornado bursts around you (up to ten foes within 6 blocks take a heavy hit and are thrown back) and you gain Speed III, Resistance II, Strength and Slow Falling for 10-15 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_sound.tuning_fork_strike: Sound: Tuning Fork Strike - a struck tuning fork throws a ringing bolt that bursts where it lands: a light hit within 1.5 blocks and Weakness for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_sound.piercing_shriek: Sound: Piercing Shriek - a high note in a wide 6 block cone: a light hit that leaves foes dizzy for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_sound.sonic_echolocation: Sound: Echolocation - a ping rolls out 16 blocks and every foe it finds (up to six) glows for 10 seconds, through walls. No damage.
nusmp.page.book_sound.bass_drop: Sound: Bass Drop - a low note shakes the ground: foes within 5 blocks take a hit, are thrown back and slowed for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_sound.subsonic_lance: Sound: Subsonic Lance - a beam of sound too low to hear runs 16 blocks: everything on the line takes a hit and is weakened for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_sound.sound_barrier: Sound: Sound Barrier - a wall of standing sound surrounds you for 3 seconds: enemy projectiles within 4.5 blocks are shattered, foes are pushed back and take a small pulse every second.
nusmp.page.book_memory.memory_flashback: Memory: Flashback - foes in a 5 block cone are thrown into a memory so vivid they cannot see the present: a light hit, Blindness and Nausea for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_memory.blank_stare: Memory: Blank Stare - foes within 3.5 blocks of where you aim forget what they were doing: mobs among them drop their target, and all are slowed and weakened for 3 seconds. No damage.
nusmp.page.book_memory.mind_probe: Memory: Mind Probe - you reach into the mind of the living thing under your crosshair (up to 20 blocks): it glows for 10 seconds and is weakened for 5, so you can learn what it does next. No damage.
nusmp.page.book_memory.oblivion_azusa_ar: Memory: Oblivion's Azusa Arrow - Marx's arrow of mana flies true and hits the first foe: a mid-tier hit that wipes its recent memory (a mob drops its target) and leaves it dizzy and slowed.
nusmp.page.book_memory.shared_memory: Memory: Shared Memory - what you know passes to you and up to five allies within 12 blocks as if remembered: Speed, Night Vision and Resistance for 10-15 seconds. Utility, no damage.
nusmp.page.book_memory.memory_labyrinth: Memory: Labyrinth of Recollection - a maze of half-remembered rooms where you aim, 5 blocks wide for 4 seconds: foes in it are pulsed, weakened, slowed, lit up, and mobs keep forgetting whom they hunt.
nusmp.page.book_permeation.magic_slip: Permeation: Magic Slip - for a moment magic and arrows slide through you: enemy projectiles within 4 blocks are removed (up to eight) and you gain Resistance III for 3 seconds. No damage.
nusmp.page.book_permeation.seeping_touch: Permeation: Seeping Touch - your hand passes into the foe in front of you (3 blocks, narrow): a light hit that saps its strength (Weakness II for 4 seconds) and slows it.
nusmp.page.book_permeation.vanish_from_s: Permeation: Vanish from Sight - you slip out of everyone's sight: mobs within 16 blocks that hunted you lose you, and you are invisible and quick (Speed II) for 7 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_permeation.unseen_creati: Permeation: Unseen Creation - three invisible creatures you made lunge at the nearest foes: the mid-tier damage is shared between them and none can be seen coming.
nusmp.page.book_permeation.seepage_trap: Permeation: Seepage Trap - the floor under the foe at your crosshair loses its hold, and it sinks, held still (shared control lock) and weakened for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_permeation.permeation_ho: Permeation: Hollow Beam - a beam that passes through everything runs 18 blocks: up to eight foes along it take a heavy hit, Weakness II and Slowness II.
nusmp.page.book_soul.soul_chill: Soul: Soul Chill - a cold touch on the soul in a 5 block cone: a light hit, Weakness for 4 seconds and a short slow.
nusmp.page.book_soul.soul_spirit_drain: Soul: Spirit Drain - a wisp of soul flies out and bursts: a light hit within 1.5 blocks, and for each foe hit you recover a little health (healing decay applies).
nusmp.page.book_soul.soul_ward: Soul: Soul Ward - you wrap the souls of you and up to five allies within 8 blocks in a guard: Absorption II for 15 seconds and Resistance for 10. No damage.
nusmp.page.book_soul.soul_mend: Soul: Soul Mend - you set the souls of you and up to five allies within 8 blocks back in order: harmful effects are removed and each heals 18 percent of their health (healing decay applies).
nusmp.page.book_soul.imprint_of_ideals: Soul: Imprint of Ideals - you press an idea on the soul under your crosshair: it stops moving for a moment (shared control lock), forgets whom it hunted and is left weakened and dizzy.
nusmp.page.book_soul.grimoire_tower_link: Soul: Grimoire Tower Link - you tap the stored magic of the towers: up to eight foes within 6 blocks take a heavy hit and lose a beneficial effect, while you and your allies within 8 blocks gain Absorption for 10 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.grasping_dea: Soul Corpse: Grasping Dead - dead hands claw out of the ground where you aim: foes within 3.5 blocks take a light hit and are held by Slowness III for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.corpse_bone_: Soul Corpse: Bone Rattle - three rattling shards of the dead fly out in a fan, weakening what they strike for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.corpse_puppe: Soul Corpse: Puppet Strings - strings of mana lash out along a 12 block line, hit everything on it and reel the foes in toward you.
nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.corpse_death: Soul Corpse: Death Rattle - the dead around you scream at once: foes within 5 blocks take a hit, are shoved back and withered for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.corpse_reven: Soul Corpse: Revenant Rush - your corpse-puppet body rushes 8 blocks and cuts through everything on the way, withering what it touches for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_soul_corpse.soul_abducto: Soul Corpse: Soul Abductor - you call the souls of you and up to five allies within 9 blocks back into their bodies: harmful effects are removed, each heals 25 percent of their health (healing decay applies) and gains Regeneration for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_song.song_forte_bubbles: Song: Forte Bubbles - a bubble filled with Song Magic floats out and bursts where it lands: foes within 2.5 blocks take a light hit and are weakened for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_song.song_silver_spiral: Song: Silver Spiral - a spiral of silver notes runs 14 blocks: everything on it takes a hit, a push and a short slow.
